ledger.x: 1958: the PRRI is proclaimed on 15 February by Lt Col Ahmad Hussein after a five-day ultimatum ('proclaimed to have been established on 15 February 1958'; infobox 17 February).

1958: the revolt against the Jakarta government begins over the named regions of Sumatra and North Sulawesi; the government 'arrested ministers, discharged commanders who supported the PRRI, and bombed key infrastructure in Sumatra' (no dates on the page).
1958: the PRRI capital moves from Padang to Bukittinggi on 17 April.
1958: Bukittinggi is lost on 4 May, when the capital becomes Kotto Tingi (infobox: Bukittinggi 17 April to 4 May 1958).
1958: the PRRI capital moves to Kotto Tingi on 4 May; it stays there to July 1960 (infobox).
1958: 'Manado was captured at the end of June 1958'; Permesta moved its headquarters to Tomohon on 24 June (infobox) and the conflict 'then moved east'.
1958: Permesta leaves Tomohon on 16 August for Kotamobagu (infobox: Tomohon 24 June to 16 August 1958); the page does not say the town was taken.
1959: Permesta's headquarters at Kotamobagu ends on 14 September (infobox: Kotamobagu 16 August 1958 to 14 September 1959); the page gives no later seat.
1960: the PRRI's last seat, Kotto Tingi, is held 'to July 1960' (infobox); the Sumatran regions pass back to the Republic.
1961: the Revolutionary Government is disestablished on 28 September (infobox); the rebel-held land is the Republic's.

wars.name: PRRI and Permesta rebellion
wars.outcome: The central government retook Padang, Bukittinggi and Manado in 1958 and the PRRI ended on 28 September 1961 with amnesties; Permesta's last commander surrendered in early 1962.

certainty.note: A rebel government with no recorded boundary; the provinces are the pages' named regions and the cities are the only dated ground.
